effect.shortEffect: Turns the sunlight harsh when entering battle, and boosts Attack while active.
effect.full: Turns the sunlight harsh when the Pokémon enters a battle. The ancient pulse thrumming through the Pokémon also boosts its Attack stat in harsh sunlight.

french.sv: Le Pokémon invoque le soleil quand il rejoint le combat.\nQuand le soleil brille, une pulsation primitive augmente\nson Attaque.

english.sv: Turns the sunlight harsh when the Pokémon enters a battle. The ancient pulse thrumming through the Pokémon also boosts its Attack stat in harsh sunlight.

japanese.sv: 登場したとき　天気を　晴れにする。 日差しが　強いと　古代の 鼓動により　攻撃が　高まる。
